author: Yffe
content: Pin (the domain bridge, §4 theorem sketch). The sketch ends 'denote fuel ens (Env.bindInt { v with specs := R_item } "result" body)' and the doc asserts concreteness: 'the result-binding uses the SHIPPED Env.bindInt'. Against the spine: (a) TYPING — Env.bindInt : Env → String → Int → Env (Denote.lean) takes an Int; 'body' is an item body, i.e. a Block denoting via Thermite.Exec.bodyDenote : Block → State → Option ExecVal (Exec/Stmt.lean) in the BOUNDED domain. As written the sketch does not typecheck; the S_E→S_C value bridge (BVal.value : Int extraction) is stated nowhere. Bool-typed results have NO binding site (Env has ints/seqs/optres only; no bool sort, no bindBool); Option/Result-typed results (the #180 match-in-ens fragment, IN per §8) need an optres binding — no Env.bindOptRes exists in Denote.lean. (b) OPTION POSITION — bodyDenote = none exactly when an exec obligation fails (overflow/div-zero/oob). The doc takes NO position between (i) conjoining 'bodyDenote v = some r ∧ ens(r)' (then REQ-1's separate OVERFLOW class is redundant for Lean-discharged items — unreconciled) and (ii) hypothesizing 'bodyDenote v = some r → ens(r)' (then an always-overflowing body satisfies ens vacuously — sound ONLY IF the aux classes are mandatory-and-conjoined per item at the certificate level; NO such per-item conjunction rule exists anywhere in the doc: REQ-1 lists classes, REQ-2 fragments per class, REQ-3/REQ-4 are per-obligation; nothing forbids an engine certifying an item on the CONTRACT class alone). (c) ENV/STATE — the contract Env ({ints,seqs,optres,specs}) and the exec State ({env : ExecEnv{vars : String → ExecVal, slices : String → List BVal}, scope}) are disjoint structures; the v-to-State correspondence (params → in-range BVal cells at their widths, seqs List Int → List BVal) is specified nowhere. The spine's own theorems relate refDenote/denote and bodyRefState/bodyDenote SEPARATELY — this sketch is the FIRST artifact tying S_C and S_E/S_B in one statement, and the doc neither owns that novelty nor scopes the sketch to increment (ii)'s PURE-CONTRACT class (where 'body' could be denoted in S_C via intVal — a choice also unstated). Fix is generator's: state the bridge + the Option position + the conjunction rule, or scope the sketch to pure-contract and mark the bridge an open design obligation for increment (iv).
